arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Right-facing standing profile with ONE visible eye, eyebrow, nose and mouth. One arm bends across the upper chest, hand close near the bib; the other arm reaches toward SCREEN-RIGHT at shoulder/chest height with elbow slightly bent and its hand angled slightly DOWN. Exactly TWO arms, two hands, no extra sleeve/hand. Keep the two legs straight in source stance and show distinct offset shoes pointing right.
